correctness.rationale: PASS. The rooted-tree hook volume is Q(T)=1/product descendant sizes. Facets are exactly the root-lower facet, leaf-upper facets and edge-equality facets; the latter inherit sqrt(2) Euclidean measure, proving A(T)=nQ(T)+sum_leaf Q(T-v)+sqrt(2) sum_edge Q(T/e). Every nonchain tree admits a fork-poset refinement; every nonstar has a pair of comparable nonroot elements yielding a broom-poset relaxation. After coordinate permutation, chain is strictly contained in fork, which is contained in any nonchain rooted tree, which is contained in broom and then star. Distinct comparability structures yield proper inclusion, and Kubota projection averaging gives strict monotonicity of all V_j for full-dimensional proper inclusion. The special area formulas follow from hook contractions.
